teile.text: These five free AI tools replace apps people pay for every month. Number one will surprise you.

teile.name: Whisper
teile.text: Number three: Whisper. It turns speech into text, runs on your own computer, and the code is open source.

teile.name: Pexels
teile.text: Number five: Pexels. Millions of stock photos and videos you can use for free, even in commercial projects.

teile.name: FFmpeg
teile.text: Number two: FFmpeg. The free engine behind countless video apps. It cuts, converts and compresses almost anything.

teile.name: Kokoro
teile.text: Number four: Kokoro. A free text to speech model with natural voices. This voice you are hearing right now is Kokoro.

teile.name: Ollama
teile.text: And number one: Ollama. It runs large language models on your own machine. No subscription, and your data stays with you.
Follow for one free AI tool every day.
